title: Fruit flavored drink with high vitamin C

content.title: About
content.content: The fruit flavored drink with a high vitamin C content (5331 mg) is a refreshing non‑alcoholic beverage made from natural fruit extracts and fortified with vitamin C. It offers a bright fruit taste, mild sweetness and a subtle tang characteristic of vitamin C.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The vitamin C level far exceeds the daily recommended intake, making it a convenient way to quickly replenish a deficiency.
The fruit base usually includes orange, lime, kiwi or berries, enhancing the natural aroma.
The drink contains no artificial colourings; colour comes from natural fruit pigments.
It is suitable for vegetarians and vegans as it contains no animal ingredients.
Packaging is often made from recyclable plastic, reducing environmental impact.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C boosts immune‑cell function and helps the body fight infections.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Vitamin C neutralises free radicals, reducing oxidative stress in cells.

items.title: Improved iron absorption
items.content: Vitamin C increases the bioavailability of iron from plant foods, beneficial for anemia.

items.title: Skin health
items.content: Vitamin C participates in collagen synthesis, supporting skin elasticity and appearance.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The drink provides fluids and electrolytes, helping maintain proper hydration.

items.title: Excessive vitamin C intake
items.content: Very high amounts of vitamin C can cause gastrointestinal upset, such as diarrhea.

items.title: Allergy to fruit components
items.content: People allergic to certain fruits (e.g., citrus) may react to the beverage.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Some versions may contain added sugar; individuals with diabetes should choose sugar‑free options.

items.title: Interaction with medications
items.content: High doses of vitamin C can affect the efficacy of certain drugs, such as anticoagulants.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Consume the drink chilled, straight from the bottle. It is convenient to carry in a bottle or glass. To reduce sweetness, dilute with water at a 1:1 ratio.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the beverage in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep it refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days.
